porcelain crabs text index | photo index Phylum Arthropoda

Subphylum Crustacea > Class Malacostraca > Order Decapoda Anomurans Family Porcellanidae Hermit porcelain crab
awaiting identification*
Family Porcellanidaeupdated Dec 2019

Where seen? This tiny porcelain crab is sometimes seen inside large shells occupied by hermit crabs on our Northern shores.

Features: Body width usually less than 1cm. Drab brown or grey. Usually seen in pairs in large shells occupied by a hermit crab.

In a shell occupied by a Striped hermit crab. Changi, Apr 05


Chek Jawa, Mar 05

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
